findings.title: Loyalty points are now awarded per cent instead of per dollar
findings.trigger: orders.place_order (not touched by this PR) passes invoice.subtotal to points_after_purchase, and points_for does int(amount), documented as a dollar amount. Invoice.subtotal is now integer cents, so a $42.50 order earns 4250 points instead of 42.
findings.impact: Every order credits 100 times the intended points (times the tier multiplier), inflating balances customers can redeem. Convert in points_for (amount // 100) or pass dollars from place_order, and add an order-level test that checks points.
